subject: RE: sentiment bot
body: Spec: $GAI and $VANT. Per ticker: today's post count, bullish/bearish/neutral split, and every post it counted. No bots, no spam. Portfolio view: holdings, cash, today's change.

outcomes.when: the player offers or agrees to take the job: to build, make, create, do, help with or take on the vibe check (the trading or stock bot, their app), in any wording ("happy to help", "I can do that", "count me in"), including asking whether they can help ("can I help you with your app?", "want me to build it?"); not a refusal or an unrelated question
outcomes.reply: Fine. Send it when it's live.

hints: Can you build it or not?
